p: King Street is Whitehaven's main pedestrianised shopping street, laid out as part of a planned Georgian grid that's often said to have influenced American town planning. This Admiral sits right in the middle of it, an adult gaming centre for over 18s only.

Whitehaven's harbour is a lovely place for a walk, with a marina full of boats and the Beacon Museum on the quayside telling the story of the town's mining, shipping and rum trade. The Coast to Coast cycle route starts here, so you'll often spot riders dipping their wheels in the harbour. And the western Lake District, including Ennerdale and Wastwater, is a short drive inland if you want some proper scenery.
